description: Land Reform Commission - Statutory Determination under Section 19 of the Land Reform Law No. 1 of 1972
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land-related matters, specifically a statutory determination by the Land Reform Commission regarding the retention of agricultural land parcels by a statutory lessee's estate. The document contains detailed descriptions of multiple land allotments with specific lot numbers, extents, locations, and survey details, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
